import type { AdminSalesPage, Sale, UserSalesSummary } from "../../types";
import type { SalesApi } from "../interfaces";
import { buildQuery, projectFetch } from "./client";

interface SaleItemDto {
  saleId: string;
  unitId: string;
  saleDate: string;
  totalPrice: number;
  paid: number;
  remaining: number;
}

interface UserSalesResponseDto {
  sales: SaleItemDto[];
  totalPrice: number;
  totalPaid: number;
  totalRemaining: number;
}

export const salesApi: SalesApi = {
  async listAll(params) {
    return projectFetch<AdminSalesPage>(
      `/api/sales${buildQuery({
        PageNumber: params?.pageNumber ?? 1,
        PageSize: params?.pageSize ?? 100,
        Search: params?.search || undefined,
        ProjectId: params?.projectId || undefined,
      })}`
    );
  },

  async getByUser(userId) {
    const dto = await projectFetch<UserSalesResponseDto>(`/api/sales/user/${userId}`);
    const summary: UserSalesSummary = {
      totalPrice: dto.totalPrice,
      totalPaid: dto.totalPaid,
      totalRemaining: dto.totalRemaining,
      // Backend doesn't return projectName/unitDetails/payments on this endpoint —
      // joining against Immeuble/Unit data would need extra calls, left blank for now.
      sales: dto.sales.map((s) => ({
        saleId: s.saleId,
        unitId: s.unitId,
        projectName: "",
        unitDetails: "",
        price: s.totalPrice,
        totalPaid: s.paid,
        remaining: s.remaining,
        saleDate: s.saleDate,
        payments: [],
      })),
    };
    return summary;
  },

  // §5.7/§6 — the sale draft flow. The backend derives the buyer, the unit and
  // the deposit from the reservation, so none of them are sent from here.
  async createDraft(body) {
    return projectFetch<Sale>("/api/sales", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
  },

  async getByReservation(reservationId) {
    // 200 with a null body is the normal "no sale yet" answer, not an error.
    const sale = await projectFetch<Sale | null>(`/api/sales/by-reservation/${reservationId}`);
    return sale ?? null;
  },

  async updateDraft(saleId, body) {
    return projectFetch<Sale>(`/api/sales/${saleId}`, {
      method: "PUT",
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
  },

  async cancelDraft(saleId, reason) {
    return projectFetch<Sale>(`/api/sales/${saleId}/cancel`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ reason }),
    });
  },
};

using FluentValidation;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.Appointments.Entities;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.FinalVisits.Entities;

namespace ProjectAPI.Api.Application.NotaryAppointments.UpdateNotaryAppointment;

public class UpdateNotaryAppointmentValidator : AbstractValidator<UpdateNotaryAppointmentCommand>
{
    public UpdateNotaryAppointmentValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.Id)
            .NotEmpty()
            .WithMessage("Id is required.");

        // Statuses come from the shared appointment lifecycle (§47.3), reused by
        // final-visit and notary appointments alike — see AppointmentAttemptStatus.
        RuleFor(x => x.Status)
            .Must(status => string.IsNullOrEmpty(status) || Enum.TryParse<AppointmentAttemptStatus>(status, out _))
            .WithMessage(
                "Status must be one of: " +
                string.Join(", ", Enum.GetNames(typeof(AppointmentAttemptStatus))) + ".");

        // §5.7 — the outcome vocabulary is fixed and distinct from the status one.
        RuleFor(x => x.Outcome)
            .Must(outcome => string.IsNullOrEmpty(outcome) || NotaryOutcomeCodes.TryParse(outcome, out _))
            .WithMessage("Outcome must be one of: " + string.Join(", ", NotaryOutcomeCodes.All) + ".");

        RuleFor(x => x.OutcomeNote)
            .MaximumLength(2000);
```

import type { NotaryAppointment, NotaryBlock, PaginatedResponse, WeeklyAvailabilitySlot } from "../../types";
import type { NotaryApi } from "../interfaces";
import { buildQuery, idempotent, newIdempotencyKey, projectFetch } from "./client";
import { notaryAppointmentStatus } from "./enums";

// Wire DTO: legacy status strings ("Requested"/"Confirmed"/…). The §5.7 outcome
// travels as its canonical UPPER_SNAKE code — unlike status, the backend never
// spoke a legacy vocabulary for it, so there is nothing to translate.
interface NotaryAppointmentDto extends Omit<NotaryAppointment, "status" | "outcome"> {
  status: string;
  outcome?: string | null;
  outcomeNote?: string | null;
}

function fromWire(dto: NotaryAppointmentDto): NotaryAppointment {
  return {
    ...dto,
    status: notaryAppointmentStatus.fromLegacy(dto.status) ?? "REQUESTED",
    outcome: (dto.outcome as NotaryAppointment["outcome"]) ?? undefined,
  };
}

function toWire(data: Partial<NotaryAppointment> & { outcomeNote?: string }) {
  const { status, outcome, previousAppointmentId: _prev, ...rest } = data;
  return {
    ...rest,
    ...(status ? { status: notaryAppointmentStatus.toLegacy(status) } : {}),
    // Sent verbatim: the backend CHECK constraint accepts exactly these codes.
    ...(outcome ? { outcome } : {}),
  };
}

// NotaryBlockDto/CreateNotaryBlockResponse both serialize as startUtc/endUtc,
// not the from/to shape NotaryBlock uses — reading either wire response
// directly as NotaryBlock left from/to undefined, so every block's dates
// rendered as "-" after reload (F6).
interface NotaryBlockWireDto {
  id: string;
  startUtc: string;
  endUtc: string;
  reason?: string | null;
}

function fromWireBlock(dto: NotaryBlockWireDto, notaryId: string): NotaryBlock {
  return { id: dto.id, notaryId, from: dto.startUtc, to: dto.endUtc, reason: dto.reason ?? undefined };
}

    });

Api.as(\"globalAdmin\");\n  return admin.get<NotaryDto>(`/api/NotaryAppointments/${id}`);\n}\n\nasync function appointmentsOf(reservationId: string) {\n  const admin = await Api.as(\"globalAdmin\");\n  return (await admin.all<NotaryDto>(\"/api/NotaryAppointments\")).filter((a) => a.reservationId === reservationId);\n}\n\nconst localInput = (d: Date) => new Date(d.getTime() - d.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000).toISOString().slice(0, 16);\n\nasync function confirmFromList(page: Page, buyerLastName: string) {\n  await page.goto(\"/admin/notary-appointments\");\n  const row = page.getByRole(\"row\").filter({ hasText: buyerLastName });\n  await expect(row).toHaveCount(1);\n  await row.getByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Confirmer\" }).click();\n}\n\ntest.describe(\"Acheteur\", { tag: \"@buyer\" }, () => {\n  test(\"buyer_appointment_request_created_with_status_requested\", async ({ page }) => {\n    const j = await st.journey(\"FINAL_VISIT\");\n    await page.goto(`/my/properties/${j.reservationId}`);\n    await page.getByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Demander un RDV notaire\" }).click();\n    const when = new Date(Date.now() + (40 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 300)) * 86400000);\n    when.setHours(14, 0, 0, 0);\n    await page.getByLabel(\"Date et heure souhaitées\").fill(localInput(when));\n    await page.getByRole(\"button\", { appointmentsOf(j.reservationId))[0];\n    expect(created.status).toMatch(/^Requested$/i);\n    const buyer = await Api.as(\"buyer\", true);\n    expect((await \"Rendez-vous notaire\", exact: true }) });\n    await expect(history.getByRole(\"row\")).toHaveCount(2); // header + the request\n  });\n\n  test(\"buyer_cannot_set_purchase_completed\", async ({ expect(page.getByRole(\"radio\")).toHaveCount(0);\n\n    const buyer = await Api.as(\"buyer\", true);\n    await expectRefused(\n      await buyer.raw(\"PUT\", `/api/NotaryAppointments/${j.notaryAppointmentId}`, { id: j.notaryAppointmentId, status: \"Completed\", outcome: \"PURCHASE_COMPLETED\" }),\n      [403],\n      \"buyer sets PURCHASE_COMPLETED\",\n    );\n    const after = await appointment(j.notaryAppointmentId!);\n    expect(after.outcome ?? null).toBeNull();\n    expect(after.status).toMatch(/^Confirmed$/i);\n    const admin = await Api.as(\"globalAdmin\");\n    expect((await admin.get<{ status: number }>(`/api/Reservations/${j.reservationId}`)).status).toBe(1);\n  });\n});\n\nfor (const [tag, label] of [[\"@agent\", \"Agent\"],     public async Task<List<MyReservationSummary>> Handle(GetMyReservationsQuery request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var userId = _currentUser.UserId;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userId)) return new List<MyReservationSummary>();

        return await _db.Set<Reservation>()
            .Where(r => r.BuyerId == userId)
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.ReservationDate)
            .Select(r => new MyReservationSummary
            {
                Id = r.Id,
                UnitId = r.UnitId,
                UnitDetails = r.UnitDetails,

                TotalPropertyPrice = r.TotalPropertyPrice,
                FinalPrice = r.FinalPrice,
                ReservationDate = r.ReservationDate,
                ValidatedAt = r.ValidatedAt
            })
            .ToListAsync(ct);
    }
}

  const immeubleId = searchParams.get("immeuble") ?? "";

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

      if (immeubleId) {
        const [im, units] = await Promise.all([
          immeublesApi.getById(immeubleId),
          immeublesApi.listUnits(immeubleId),
        ]);
        if (cancelled) return;
        setImmeuble(im ?? null);
        setUnit(units.find((u) => u.id === unitId) ?? null);
        return;
      }

      // Fallback: there is no GET /units/{id}, so locate the unit by scanning
      // each immeuble's units until we find its owner.

        const match = units.find((u) => u.id === unitId);
        if (match) {
          if (cancelled) return;
          setImmeuble(im);
          setUnit(match);

      if (!cancelled) setUnit(null);

    return () => {

          </Card>
          <Card className="stat-card">

            <span className="stat-value">{unit.numberOfBedrooms ?? "-"}</span>
          </Card>

﻿using FluentValidation;
using MediatR;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Common.Exceptions;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Common.Models;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Sales.AfterSales.CreateAfterSaleClaim;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Sales.AfterSales.GetClaims;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Sales.AfterSales.GetMyClaims;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Sales.AfterSales.RespondToClaimResolution;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Sales.AfterSales.UpdateClaimStatus;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Common.Security;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.Users.Entities;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using ValidationException = FluentValidation.ValidationException;

namespace ProjectAPI.Api.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/after-sales/claims")]
[Authorize] // §6.3 SAV: buyer creates own (C/M propre); technician/admin handle (C/M affecté).
public class AfterSaleClaimsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IMediator _mediator;
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;

    public AfterSaleClaimsController(IMediator mediator, ICurrentUser currentUser)
    {
        _mediator = mediator;
        _currentUser = currentUser;
    }

    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<ActionResult<object>> Create([FromBody] CreateAfterSaleClaimCommand cmd, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // BuyerId is taken from the token, NOT merely defaulted from it.
        //
        // It used to be filled in only when the body left it blank, so a buyer
        // could send someone else's id and have the claim attributed to them:
        // the ownership check downstream verifies that THAT id owns the unit,
        // which it does, so the impersonation passed every check. §6.4 —
        // "un acheteur ne peut accéder qu'à ses propres données".
        //
        // An internal caller (admin/technician) may still file on a buyer's
        // behalf, which is a real workflow — a claim phoned in to the SAV desk.
        // Only a buyer/prospect caller is pinned to themselves.
        //
        // MUST go through ICurrentUser, not a raw ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier
        // lookup — this system's JWTs carry the id under a custom "userId"
        // claim, which ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier never matches (see CurrentUser.cs).
        var isInternal = _currentUser.Roles.Any(r => RoleCodes.Internal.Contains(r, StringComparer.Ordinal));

        if (!isInternal && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_currentUser.UserId))
        {
            cmd.BuyerId = _currentUser.UserId;
        }
        else if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cmd.BuyerId) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_currentUser.UserId))
        {
            cmd.BuyerId = _currentUser.UserId;
        }

        try
        {
            var id = await _mediator.Send(cmd, ct);
            // No GetById handler exists, so return 200 with the id payload.
            return Ok(new { id });
        }
        catch (ValidationException ex)
        {
            // Handler throws FluentValidation.ValidationException for business rules
            return ValidationProblem(detail: ex.Message);
        }
    }

    [HttpPost("{claimId:guid}/attachments")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(Application.Sales.AfterSales.Attachments.ClaimAttachmentResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status422UnprocessableEntity)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UploadAttachment(
        Guid claimId,
        [FromForm] Application.Sales.AfterSales.Attachments.UploadClaimAttachmentCommand command,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (command.File is null || command.File.Length == 0)
        {
            return BadRequest("No file uploaded.");
        }

        command.ClaimId = claimId;
        return Ok(await _mediator.Send(command, ct));
    }

    [HttpGet("attachments/{attachmentId:guid}/content")]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
    [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DownloadAttachment(Guid attachmentId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var file = await _mediator.Send(
            new Application.Sales.AfterSales.Attachments.DownloadClaimAttachmentQuery
            {
                AttachmentId = attachmentId
            }, ct);

        return File(file.Content, file.ContentType, file.FileName);
    }

    public Guid ClaimId { get; set; }
    public IFormFile File { get; set; } = null!;
}

public class ClaimAttachmentResponse
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public Guid ClaimId { get; set; }
    public string? FileName { get; set; }
    public string? ContentType { get; set; }
    public long? SizeBytes { get; set; }
    public DateTime UploadedAt { get; set; }
}

public class UploadClaimAttachmentHandler : IRequestHandler<UploadClaimAttachmentCommand, ClaimAttachmentResponse>
{
    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;
    private readonly IBlobStorageService _blobStorage;
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;

    public UploadClaimAttachmentHandler(
        ApplicationDbContext db,
        IBlobStorageService blobStorage,
        ICurrentUser currentUser)
    {
        _db = db;
        _blobStorage = blobStorage;
        _currentUser = currentUser;
    }

    public async Task<ClaimAttachmentResponse> Handle(UploadClaimAttachmentCommand request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var claim = await _db.Set<AfterSaleClaim>()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == request.ClaimId, ct)
            ?? throw new NotFoundException($"Claim {request.ClaimId} not found.");

        await ClaimAccess.EnsureCanAccessAsync(_db, _currentUser, claim, ct);

        var contentType = request.File.ContentType ?? "application/octet-stream";

        if (!ClaimAttachmentStorage.AllowedContentTypes.Contains(contentType, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            throw new BusinessRuleException(
                BusinessErrorCodes.ValidationFailed,
                $"Type de fichier non autorisé ({contentType}). " +
                "Formats acceptés : photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC), vidéo (MP4, MOV) ou PDF.");
        }

        if (request.File.Length > ClaimAttachmentStorage.MaxSizeBytes)
        {
            throw new BusinessRuleException(
                BusinessErrorCodes.ValidationFailed,
                $"Fichier trop volumineux ({request.File.Length / 1024 / 1024} Mo). Maximum : 25 Mo.");
        }

        // Guid prefix so re-uploading "photo.jpg" never overwrites the first,
        // and the claim id groups a file with the claim it evidences.
        var blobName = $"{claim.Id}/{Guid.NewGuid()}_{Path.GetFileName(request.File.FileName)}";

        using var stream = request.File.OpenReadStream();
        var url = await _blobStorage.ForContainer(ClaimAttachmentStorage.ContainerName)
            .UploadAsync(blobName, stream, contentType, ct);

# Workflow — Buyer account activation by invitation

**Status: fully traced**, across both services. This is the only workflow in the
solution that crosses the ProjectAPI ↔ AuthenticationAPI boundary at runtime.

## Business purpose

A buyer can be recorded and approved without ever having a login — an agent
enters a walk-in on the reservation's own identity fields. Approval then issues a
single-use invitation so that person can set their own password and reach the
buyer portal. The system must never invent a password for them, and never create
a second CRM contact for someone it already knows.

Ownership is split deliberately: **ProjectAPI owns the invitation and the CRM
contact; AuthenticationAPI is the only service that ever calls
`UserManager.CreateAsync`.**

## Participants

| Layer | Component |
|---|---|
| Frontend | `features/auth/ActivateAccountPage.tsx` (route `/activate?token=…`) |
| Adapter | `api/http/invitationsApi.ts` |
| ProjectAPI | `ApproveReservationHandler`, `AccountInvitationService`, `InvitationsController`, `AcceptInvitationHandler`, `AuthenticationApiClient` |
| AuthenticationAPI | `InternalController`, `ProvisionInternalUserHandler` |
| Tables | `AccountInvitations`, `CrmContacts`, `Reservations` (ProjectAPI) · `AspNetUsers`, `AspNetRoles`, `AspNetUserRoles` (AuthenticationAPI) |

## Step-by-step trace

### 1 — Approval issues the token

Inside `ApproveReservationHandler`, **after** the approval transaction commits
(so a failure here never rolls back a real approval):

'''
if (hasBuyerAccount)            → GrantBuyerRoleAsync(...)
else if (PrimaryContactId != null) → IssueInvitationAsync(...)
'''

`IAccountInvitationService.IssueAsync(crmContactId)`:

Shared by the SAV desk and the buyer portal; `mode` decides which\n * forms are offered — the API enforces the same split.\n */\nexport function ClaimDetailView({\n  claimId,\n  mode,\n  canWork,\n  onChanged,\n}: {\n  claimId: string;\n  /** \"staff\" = technician / technical lead / admin, \"buyer\" = the claim's owner. */\n  mode: \"staff\" | \"buyer\";\n  /** Staff only: may write work-done messages and before/after photos on this claim. */\n  canWork?: boolean;\n  onChanged?: () => void;\n}) {\n  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<ClaimDetail | null>(null);\n  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);\n  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<\"BEFORE\" | \"AFTER\">(\"BEFORE\");\n\n  const load = useCallback(async () => {\n    try {\n      setDetail(await claimsApi.getDetail(claimId));\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : \"Impossible de charger la réclamation.\");\n    }\n  }, [claimId]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    void load();\n  }, [load]);\n\n  const closed = detail ? [\"CLOSED\", \"CANCELLED\", \"REJECTED\"].includes(detail.status) : true;\n\n  async function sendMessage(e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const form = e.currentTarget;\n    const data = new FormData(form);\n    const message = String(data.get(\"message\") || \"\").trim();\n    if (!message) return;\n    setError(null);\n    setBusy(true);\n    try {\n      const kind: ClaimCommentKind | undefined = mode === \"staff\" ? (String(data.get(\"kind\") || \"NOTE\") as ClaimCommentKind) : undefined;\n      await claimsApi.addComment(claimId, message, kind);\n      form.reset();\n      await load();\n      onChanged?.();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : \"Échec de l'envoi du message.\");\n    } finally {\n      setBusy(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async function uploadPhoto(file: File | undefined, input: HTMLInputElement) {\n    if (!file) return;\n    setError(null);\n    setBusy(true);\n    try {\n      await claimsApi.uploadAttachment(claimId, file, mode === \"staff\" && canWork ? phase : undefined);\n      await load();\n      onChanged?.();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : \"Échec de l'envoi du fichier.\");\n    } finally {\n      input.value = \"\";\n      setBusy(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async function openAttachment(id: string) {\n    try {\n      const blob = await claimsApi.downloadAttachment(id);\n      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n      window.open(url, \"_blank\", \"noopener\");\n      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60_000);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : \"Impossible d'ouvrir la pièce jointe.\");\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (!detail) return error ? <p className=\"form-error\" role=\"alert\">{error}</p> : <Loading />;\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"claim-detail\">\n      {error && <p className=\"form-error\" role=\"alert\">{error}</p>}\n\n      <dl className=\"detail-list\">\n        <dt>Titre</dt>\n        <dd>{detail.title}</dd>\n        <dt>Description</dt>\n        <dd style={{ whiteSpace: \"pre-line\" }}>{detail.description}</dd>\n        <dt>Catégorie</dt>\n        <dd>{detail.category}</dd>\n        <dt>Priorité</dt>\n        <dd>{detail.priority}</dd>\n        <dt>Statut</dt>\n        <dd><StatusBadge status={detail.status} label={CLAIM_STATUS_LABEL[detail.status]} /></dd>\n        <dt>Technicien</dt>\n        <dd>{detail.assignedAgentName || \"Non assigné\"}</dd>\n        <dt>Créée le</dt>\n        <dd>{formatDate(detail.createdAt)}</dd>\n        {detail.resolutionSummary && (<><dt>Résolution</dt><dd>{detail.resolutionSummary}</dd></>)}\n      </dl>\n\n      <UnitContextDetails context={detail.unitContext} />\n\n      <section aria-label=\"Suivi de la réclamation\" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>\n        <h4 style={{ margin: \"0 0 8px\" }}>Suivi</h4>\n        {detail.history.length === 0 ? (\n          <p className=\"muted small\">Réclamation soumise, en attente de prise en charge.</p>\n        ) : (\n          <ol className=\"plain-list\">\n            {detail.history.map((h, i) => (\n              <li key={i}>\n                {formatDateTime(h.changedAt)} — {CLAIM_STATUS_LABEL[h.fromStatus]} → <strong>{CLAIM_STATUS_LABEL[h.toStatus]}</strong>\n                {h.changedByName ? ` (${h.changedByName})` : \"\"}\n                {h.note ? ` : ${h.note}` : \"\"}\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ol>\n        )}\n      </section>\n\n      <section aria-label=\"Messages\" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>\n        <h4 style={{ margin: \"0 0 8px\" }}>Messages</h4>\n        {detail.comments.length === 0 ? (\n          <p className=\"muted small\">Aucun message.</p>\n        ) : (\n          <ul className=\"plain-list\">\n            {detail.comments.map((c) => (\n              <li key={c.id} data-kind={c.kind} style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>\n                <span className=\"muted small\">\n                  {KIND_LABEL[c.kind]} · {c.authorName || \"—\"} · {formatDateTime(c.createdAt)}\n                </span>\n                <div style={{ whiteSpace: \"pre-line\" }}>{c.message}</div>\n              </li>\n            ))}\n          </ul>\n        )}\n        {!closed && (mode === \"buyer\" || canWork) && (\n          <form onSubmit={sendMessage} className=\"inline-form\" style={{ flexDirection: \"column\", alignItems: \"stretch\" }}>\n            {mode === \"staff\" && (\n              <Field label=\"Type de message\">\n                <select name=\"kind\" defaultValue=\"WORK_DONE\" disabled={busy}>\n                  <option value=\"WORK_DONE\">Travaux effectués</option>\n                  <option value=\"NOTE\">Note</option>\n                </select>\n              </Field>\n            )}\n            <Field label={mode === \"buyer\" ? \"Votre réponse\" : \"Message\"}>\n              <textarea name=\"message\" rows={3} required maxLength={2000} disabled={busy} />\n            </Field>\n            <Button type=\"submit\" disabled={busy}>{busy ? \"Envoi…\" : mode === \"buyer\" ? \"Répondre\" : \"Ajouter le message\"}</Button>\n          </form>\n        )}\n      </section>\n\n      <section aria-label=\"Pièces jointes\" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>\n        <h4 style={{ margin: \"0 0 8px\" }}>Pièces jointes</h4>\n        {detail.attachments.length === 0 ? (\n          <p className=\"muted small\">Aucune pièce jointe.</p>\n        ) : (\n          <Table\n            keyField={(a) => a.id}\n            rows={detail.attachments}\n            columns={[\n              {\n                header: \"Fichier\",\n                render: (a) => (\n                  <button type=\"button\" className=\"btn-link\" onClick={() => openAttachment(a.id)}>\n                    {a.fileName || \"Pièce jointe\"}\n                  </button>\n                ),\n              },\n              { header: \"Phase\", render: (a) => (a.phase ? PHASE_LABEL[a.phase] : \"-\") },\n              { header: \"Ajoutée le\", render: (a) => formatDateTime(a.uploadedAt) },\n            ]}\n          />\n        )}\n        {!closed && (mode === \"buyer\" || canWork) && (\n          <div style={{ display: \"flex\", gap: 8, flexWrap: \"wrap\", alignItems: \"center\", marginTop: 8 }}>\n            {mode === \"staff\" && (\n              <label className=\"list-filter-select\">\n                <span>Photo</span>\n                <select value={phase} onChange={(e) => setPhase(e.target.value as \"BEFORE\" | \"AFTER\")} disabled={busy}>\n                  <option value=\"BEFORE\">Avant intervention</option>\n                  <option value=\"AFTER\">Après intervention</option>\n                </select>\n              </label>\n            )}\n            <input\n              type=\"file\"\n              accept=\"image/*,video/mp4,video/quicktime,application/pdf\"\n              aria-label={mode === \"staff\" ? \"Ajouter une photo\" : \"Ajouter une pièce jointe\"}\n              disabled={busy}\n              onChange={(e) => uploadPhoto(e.target.files?.[0], e.currentTarget)}\n            />\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </section>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"

567	function sql(query: string) {
568	  const db = process.env.E2E_PROJECT_DB ?? "GPIA_Project_QA";
569	  const server = process.env.E2E_SQL_SERVER ?? ".\\SQLEXPRESS";
570	  return execFileSync("sqlcmd", ["-S", server, "-d", db, "-I", "-b", "-W", "-h", "-1", "-Q", `SET NOCOUNT ON; ${query}`], { stdio: "pipe" }).toString();
571	}

573	/** Runs raw SQL against the QA database and returns sqlcmd's output (test-only fault injection / probes). */
574	export const runSql = sql;
575	
576	/**
577	 * Fault injection for atomicity tests: while `fn` runs, any INSERT of a sale on
578	 * this unit fails inside the database (AFTER INSERT trigger raising an error),
579	 * so the notary handler's transaction must roll back everything it did before.
580	 */
581	export async function withSaleInsertFailure<T>(unitId: string, fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
582	  const name = `e2e_fail_sale_${unitId.replace(/-/g, "")}`;
583	  sql(`EXEC('CREATE TRIGGER [${name}] ON [Sales] AFTER INSERT AS IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted WHERE UnitId = ''${unitId}'') THROW 50001, ''e2e injected sale failure'', 1;')`);
584	  try {
585	    return await fn();
586	  } finally {
587	    sql(`DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS [${name}]`);
588	  }
589	}
590	
591	/**
592	 * Time travel for the warranty: no API can age a warranty, so this moves its
593	 * end date into the past directly in the QA database. Used only to reach the
594	 * "warranty expired" state; the rule itself is still asserted through the API/UI.
595	 */
596	export function expireWarranty(unitId: string) {
597	  const db = process.env.E2E_PROJECT_DB ?? "GPIA_Project_QA";
598	  const server = process.env.E2E_SQL_SERVER ?? ".\\SQLEXPRESS";
599	  execFileSync(
600	    "sqlcmd",
601	    ["-S", server, "-d", db, "-I", "-b", "-Q", `SET NOCOUNT ON; UPDATE Warranties SET StartsAt = DATEADD(month,-30,GETUTCDATE()), EndsAt = DATEADD(day,-1,GETUTCDATE()) WHERE UnitId = '${unitId}'`],
602	    { stdio: "pipe" },
603	  );
604	}

224	public class AddClaimCommentHandler : IRequestHandler<AddClaimCommentCommand, ClaimCommentDto>
225	{
226	    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;
227	    private readonly ProjectScopeService _scope;
228	    private readonly ICurrentUser _user;
229	
230	    public AddClaimCommentHandler(ApplicationDbContext db, ProjectScopeService scope, ICurrentUser user)
231	    {
232	        _db = db;
233	        _scope = scope;
234	        _user = user;
235	    }
236	
237	    public async Task<ClaimCommentDto> Handle(AddClaimCommentCommand request, CancellationToken ct)
238	    {
239	        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Message))
240	        {
241	            throw new Common.Exceptions.ValidationException(new[] { new FluentValidation.Results.ValidationFailure("Message", "Le message est obligatoire.") });
242	        }
243	        if (request.Message.Length > 2000)
244	        {
245	            throw new Common.Exceptions.ValidationException(new[] { new FluentValidation.Results.ValidationFailure("Message", "Le message ne peut dépasser 2000 caractères.") });
246	        }
247	
248	        var claim = await _db.Set<AfterSaleClaim>().FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == request.ClaimId, ct)
249	            ?? throw new NotFoundException($"Claim {request.ClaimId} not found.");
250	
251	        await ClaimAccessPolicy.EnsureCanAccessAsync(_db, _scope, _user, claim, ct);
252	
253	        if (claim.Status is ClaimStatus.Closed or ClaimStatus.Cancelled or ClaimStatus.Rejected)
254	        {
255	            throw new BusinessRuleException(BusinessErrorCodes.InvalidStatusTransition,
256	                "La réclamation est clôturée : aucun message ne peut plus y être ajouté.", StatusCodes.Status409Conflict);
257	        }
258	
259	        var isStaff = ClaimAccessPolicy.IsSupervisor(_user) || ClaimAccessPolicy.IsAssignedTechnician(_user, claim);
260	        var kind = isStaff
261	            ? (string.Equals(request.Kind, ClaimCommentKinds.WorkDone, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? ClaimCommentKinds.WorkDone : ClaimCommentKinds.Note)
262	            : ClaimCommentKinds.Reply;
263	
264	        var comment = new ClaimComment
265	        {
266	            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
267	            ClaimId = claim.Id,
268	            AuthorUserId = _user.UserId!,
269	            Message = request.Message.Trim(),
270	            Kind = kind,
271	            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
272	        };
273	        _db.Add(comment);
274	        claim.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
275	        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
276	
277	        return new ClaimCommentDto { Id = comment.Id, Kind = kind, Message = comment.Message, AuthorUserId = comment.AuthorUserId, CreatedAt = comment.CreatedAt };
278	    }
279	}

286	/// <summary>A unit the signed-in buyer may file a claim on, with where it is and its sale.</summary>
287	public class ClaimEligibleUnitDto
288	{
289	    public Guid UnitId { get; set; }
290	    public Guid SaleId { get; set; }
291	    public DateTime WarrantyEndsAt { get; set; }
292	    public UnitContextDto UnitContext { get; set; } = new();
293	}

295	public class GetClaimEligibleUnitsHandler : IRequestHandler<GetClaimEligibleUnitsQuery, List<ClaimEligibleUnitDto>>
296	{
297	    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;
298	    private readonly ICurrentUser _user;
299	
300	    public GetClaimEligibleUnitsHandler(ApplicationDbContext db, ICurrentUser user)
301	    {
302	        _db = db;
303	        _user = user;
304	    }
305	
306	    public async Task<List<ClaimEligibleUnitDto>> Handle(GetClaimEligibleUnitsQuery request, CancellationToken ct)
307	    {
308	        var userId = _user.UserId;
309	        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userId)) return new();
310	        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
311	
312	        // Confirmed sale of a converted reservation owned by the caller, on a
313	        // delivered unit, with an active warranty — the same rule as claim creation.
314	        var rows = await (
315	            from s in _db.Set<Sale>()
316	            join r in _db.Set<Reservation>() on s.ReservationId equals r.Id
317	            join u in _db.Set<UnitEntity>() on s.UnitId equals u.Id
318	            where s.Status == SaleStatus.Confirmed
319	               && r.BuyerId == userId
320	               && u.Status == UnitCommercialStatus.Delivered
321	            select new { s.UnitId, SaleId = s.Id }
322	        ).ToListAsync(ct);
323	
324	        var unitIds = rows.Select(r => r.UnitId).Distinct().ToList();
325	        var warranties = await _db.Warranties
326	            .Where(w => unitIds.Contains(w.UnitId) && w.IsActive && w.EndsAt > now)
327	            .GroupBy(w => w.UnitId)
328	            .Select(g => new { UnitId = g.Key, EndsAt = g.Max(w => w.EndsAt) })
329	            .ToDictionaryAsync(x => x.UnitId, x => x.EndsAt, ct);
330	
331	        var contexts = await UnitLocations.ForUnitsAsync(_db, warranties.Keys, ct);
332	
333	        return rows
334	            .Where(r => warranties.ContainsKey(r.UnitId) && contexts.ContainsKey(r.UnitId))
335	            .GroupBy(r => r.UnitId)
336	            .Select(g => new ClaimEligibleUnitDto
337	            {
338	                UnitId = g.Key,
339	                SaleId = g.First().SaleId,
340	                WarrantyEndsAt = warranties[g.Key],
341	                UnitContext = contexts[g.Key]
342	            })
343	            .ToList();
344	    }
345	}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Common.Exceptions;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.Immeubles.Entities;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.Purchases.Interfaces;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.Reservations.Entities;

using ProjectAPI.Domain.Sales.Interfaces;
using ProjectAPI.Infrastructure.Context;
using ValidationException = FluentValidation.ValidationException;
using UnitEntity = ProjectAPI.Domain.Immeubles.Entities.Unit;

namespace ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Sales.AfterSales.CreateAfterSaleClaim;

/// <summary>
/// Opens a SAV/warranty claim (spec §5.9, §20).
///
/// Only for a unit that is DELIVERED and within an active warranty — a claim
/// on a unit that never reached delivery has nothing to warrant. The claim
/// starts SUBMITTED; a project admin qualifies it into UNDER_REVIEW and
/// beyond via UpdateClaimStatusHandler.
/// </summary>
public class CreateAfterSaleClaimHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateAfterSaleClaimCommand, Guid>
{
    private readonly IAfterSaleClaimRepository _claimRepo;
    private readonly IClaimAttachmentRepository _attachRepo;
    private readonly IPurchaseRepository _purchaseRepo;
    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;

    public CreateAfterSaleClaimHandler(
        IAfterSaleClaimRepository claimRepo,
        IClaimAttachmentRepository attachRepo,
        IPurchaseRepository purchaseRepo,
        ApplicationDbContext db)
    {
        _claimRepo = claimRepo;
        _attachRepo = attachRepo;
        _purchaseRepo = purchaseRepo;
        _db = db;
    }

    public async Task<Guid> Handle(CreateAfterSaleClaimCommand r, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // §5.9/§6.3 — a warranty claim must reference a DELIVERED unit.
        var unit = await _db.Set<UnitEntity>().FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == r.UnitId, ct)
            ?? throw new NotFoundException($"Unit {r.UnitId} not found.");

        if (unit.Status != UnitCommercialStatus.Delivered)
        {
            throw BusinessRuleException.PropertyNotDelivered(r.UnitId);
        }

        // §5.9/§6 — the warranty exists because a sale was concluded, so the
        // sale is the thing that has to be there. A DELIVERED unit with no
        // confirmed sale behind it is a data fault (a hand-edited status, a
        // half-finished import), and a claim opened against it has no
        // contractual counterparty to answer for it.
        var confirmedSale = await _db.Set<Sale>()
            .Where(s => s.UnitId == r.UnitId && s.Status == SaleStatus.Confirmed)
            .OrderByDescending(s => s.ConfirmedAt)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

        if (confirmedSale is null)
        {
            throw BusinessRuleException.PropertyNotDelivered(r.UnitId);
        }

        // §5.9 — an active warranty is a prerequisite, not just a display fact.
        var warranty = await _db.Warranties
            .Where(w => w.UnitId == r.UnitId && w.IsActive && w.EndsAt > DateTime.UtcNow)
            .OrderByDescending(w => w.StartsAt)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

        if (warranty is null)
        {
            throw BusinessRuleException.WarrantyExpired(r.UnitId);
        }

        Guid? purchaseId = null;
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(r.BuyerId))
        {
            // §5.9/§6.4 — must actually own THIS unit, not merely own some
            // purchase somewhere (the original bug this session fixed). But
            // the legacy Purchase row is only ever created by
            // ApproveReservationHandler, and only when the buyer already had
            // an account AT THE MOMENT OF APPROVAL (hasBuyerAccount). A buyer
            // invited and activated afterward (§1.1/§6.2 Phase 2 — N20) never
            // gets a retroactive Purchase row, so this check had nothing to
            // match against for the exact case it exists to protect: a real,
            // delivered, warrantied owner. Reservation.BuyerId is the current,
            // always-populated signal (set at submit, or backfilled on
            // invitation acceptance) — check that directly instead of the
            // Purchase table, which is a display convenience, not the source
            // of truth for ownership.
            // Ownership is the CONFIRMED sale's reservation, not any reservation the
            // user ever had on the unit (a former, cancelled buyer passed that check).
            var ownsUnit = confirmedSale.BuyerId == r.BuyerId
                || await _db.Set<Reservation>().AnyAsync(res =>
                    res.Id == confirmedSale.ReservationId && res.BuyerId == r.BuyerId, ct);
            if (!ownsUnit)
                throw BusinessRuleException.BuyerScopeDenied();

            var buyerPurchases = await _purchaseRepo.Find(p =>
                p.UserId == r.BuyerId
                && ((p.Reservation != null && p.Reservation.UnitId == r.UnitId)
                    || (p.Sale != null && p.Sale.UnitId == r.UnitId)));
            purchaseId = buyerPurchases.FirstOrDefault()?.Id;
        }

        var claim = new AfterSaleClaim
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            UnitId = r.UnitId,
            PurchaseId = purchaseId,
            WarrantyId = warranty.Id,
            BuyerId = r.BuyerId,
            GuestName = r.BuyerId == null ? r.GuestName : null,
            GuestEmail = r.BuyerId == null ? r.GuestEmail : null,
            GuestPhone = r.BuyerId == null ? r.GuestPhone : null,
            Title = r.Title,
            Description = r.Description,
            Category = r.Category,
            Priority = r.Priority,
            Status = ClaimStatus.Submitted,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        await _claimRepo.InsertAsync(claim);
        await _claimRepo.SaveAsync();

        // Attachments are uploaded as files against the created claim
        // (POST /api/claims/{id}/attachments), never accepted as URLs here.
        return claim.Id;
    }
}

  test("warranty_duration_set_by_project_admin_on_project", async ({ page }) => {
    const p = await st.createProject({ warrantyMonths: 12 });
    await page.goto(`/admin/projects/${p.id}`);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Modifier" }).click();
    const edit = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Modifier le projet" });
    await edit.getByLabel("Garantie (mois)").fill("30");
    await edit.getByRole("button", { name: "Enregistrer" }).click();
    await expect(edit).toBeHidden();
    expect((await st.getProject(p.id, "projectAdmin")).warrantyMonths).toBe(30);

    // Only admins can set it.
    const agent = await Api.as("agent");
    await expectRefused(

      [403],
      "agent sets warranty",
    );

  test("warranty_duration_frozen_after_sale_confirmed", async ({ page }) => {
    const j = await st.journey("SOLD", { warrantyMonths: 24 });
    expect((await st.getSale(j.reservationId))!.warrantyMonths).toBe(24);

    // The project admin changes the project's warranty afterwards.
    await page.goto(`/admin/projects/${j.project.id}`);
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Modifier" }).click();
    const edit = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Modifier le projet" });
    await edit.getByLabel("Garantie (mois)").fill("60");
    await edit.getByRole("button", { name: "Enregistrer" }).click();
    await expect(edit).toBeHidden();
    expect((await st.getProject(j.project.id, "projectAdmin")).warrantyMonths).toBe(60);

    // The confirmed sale keeps its own copy, and the delivered warranty follows the sale.
    expect((await st.getSale(j.reservationId))!.warrantyMonths).toBe(24);
    await st.deliverUnit(j);
    const buyer = await Api.as("buyer", true);
    const warranties = await buyer.get<WarrantyDto[]>(`/api/Handovers/reservations/${j.reservationId}/warranties/mine`);
    expect(monthsBetween(warranties[0].startsAt, warranties[0].endsAt)).toBe(24);
  });
});

19	 * server-side (GetMyHandoverStatusHandler/GetMyWarrantiesHandler) — there is

24	export function BuyerHandoverCard({ reservationId }: { reservationId: string }) {

33	  }
34	
35	  useEffect(load, [reservationId]);
36	
37	  async function acknowledge() {
38	    if (!handover?.reportId) return;
39	    setError(null);
40	    setBusy(true);

42	      await handoversApi.acknowledge(handover.reportId);
43	      load();
44	    } catch (err) {
45	      setError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : "Échec de la confirmation de réception.");
46	    } finally {

70	              </span>
71	            </Card>

74	                <span className="stat-label">Procès-verbal</span>

77	                </span>

80	                )}
81	              </Card>
82	            )}
83	          </div>
84	
85	          {handover.items.length > 0 && (

87	              keyField={(i) => i.itemType}
88	              rows={handover.items}
89	              columns={[

91	                { header: "Quantité", render: (i) => i.quantity, align: "right" },
92	                { header: "Commentaire", render: (i) => i.comment ?? "-" },
93	              ]}
94	            />
95	          )}
96	
97	          {handover.reportStatus === "AWAITING_BUYER_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT" && (
98	            <div className="modal-actions" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
99	              <Button onClick={acknowledge} disabled={busy}>
100	                {busy ? "…" : "Confirmer la réception"}
101	              </Button>
102	            </div>
103	          )}
104	        </>
105	      )}
106	
107	      {warranties.length > 0 && (
108	        <>
109	          <h4 style={{ marginTop: handover ? 16 : 0 }}>Garanties</h4>
110	          <Table
111	            keyField={(w) => w.id}
112	            rows={warranties}
113	            columns={[

123	        </>

  test("handover_available_only_after_sale_confirmed", async ({ page }) => {
    const draft = await st.journey("DRAFT_SALE");
    const agent = await Api.as("agent");

    // Sale not confirmed: no delivery section, API refuses to schedule.
    const draftDetail = await openReservation(page, draft.project.name, draft.buyerLastName);
    await expect(draftDetail.getByRole("heading", { name: "Livraison", exact: true })).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(draftDetail.getByRole("button", { name: "Planifier la livraison" })).toHaveCount(0);
    await expectRefused(
      await agent.raw("POST", "/api/Handovers", { reservationId: draft.reservationId, scheduledAt: "2027-06-01T10:00:00" }),
      [409, 422],
      "handover before confirmed sale",
    );
    await page.keyboard.press("Escape");

    // Sale confirmed (PURCHASE_COMPLETED): the delivery can be planned from the UI.
    const sold = await st.journey("SOLD");
    expect((await st.getSale(sold.reservationId))!.status).toBe("Confirmed");
    const detail = await openReservation(page, sold.project.name, sold.buyerLastName);
    await detail.getByRole("button", { name: "Planifier la livraison" }).click();
    const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog").filter({ has: page.getByLabel("Lieu") }).last();
    await field(dialog, "Date et heure").fill("2027-06-15T10:00");
    await field(dialog, "Lieu").fill("Sur site (E2E)");
    await dialog.locator("button[type=submit]").click();
    await expect(dialog).toBeHidden();
    await expect
      .poll(orNull(async () => (await agent.get<{ appointmentId?: string }>(`/api/Handovers/reservations/${sold.reservationId}/mine`)).appointmentId ?? null))
      .not.toBeNull();
  });
```
</details>

param([switch]$SkipAuth)

$repo = "C:\Users\LEGION\source\repos\whiredead\realestate"

function Stop-Port($port) {
  Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
}

Push-Location $repo
try {
  Stop-Port 48989
  if (-not $SkipAuth) { Stop-Port 48988 }
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
  $out = dotnet build src/ProjectAPI/src/Api/ProjectAPI.Api.csproj -o "$S\pbuild" 2>&1

# Fixes — SAV claims (frontend)

## Every claim action offered to every role; no closure validation
- **Files:** `src/features/claims/ClaimsPage.tsx`, `src/types/index.ts` (`AfterSaleClaim.assignedAgentId`)
- **Wrong:** "Mettre en cours d'analyse" / "Affecter un technicien" were shown to technicians; "Démarrer" / "Résoudre" to technicians not assigned; nothing let the lead validate a resolved claim's closure.
- **Changed:** qualification and assignment shown only to `CLAIM_SUPERVISORS`; start/resolve only to the assignee or a supervisor; new "Valider la clôture" (RESOLVED → CLOSED) for supervisors.
====
# Fixes — After-sales claims

## Technician could assign, reject and close claims
- **Files:** `src/ProjectAPI/src/Api/Application/Sales/AfterSales/UpdateClaimStatus/UpdateClaimStatusHandler.cs`
- **Wrong:** any TECHNICIAN assigned to a claim could move it to any state the state machine allowed, including `Closed` (validation of closure) and `Assigned`.
- **Changed:** supervisors (GLOBAL_ADMIN, PROJECT_ADMIN, TECH_LEAD) may apply any valid transition. A technician must be the assignee and may only target `InProgress`, `WaitingCustomer`, `Resolved`; anything else → 403 `UNAUTHORIZED`.

## Technical lead restricted like a technician when listing
- **Files:** `src/ProjectAPI/src/Api/Application/Sales/AfterSales/GetClaims/GetClaimsHandler.cs`
- **Wrong:** the "assigned to me only" filter applied to anyone holding TECHNICIAN, even when also a supervisor.
- **Changed:** the filter applies only to technicians who are not TECH_LEAD / admin; supervisors see their project perimeter.

## Claim list did not expose the assignee
- **Files:** `GetClaims/AfterSaleClaimResponse.cs`, `GetClaims/GetClaimsHandler.cs`
- **Wrong:** the SAV screen could not know whether the signed-in technician was the assignee, so it offered every action to everyone.
- **Changed:** `AssignedAgentId` added to the response.
===
## Reservation / notary lists failed silently
- **Files:** `features/reservations/ReservationsPage.tsx`, `features/notary/NotaryAppointmentsPage.tsx`
- **Wrong:** list and filter loads had no `catch`: a 401/403/500 left an eternal skeleton or empty table with the error only in the console.
- **Changed:** the error is shown (`role="alert"`) above the table.

## Quartier / type-de-bien forms lost what the user typed
- **Files:** `src/features/quartiers/QuartiersPage.tsx`, `src/features/typebiens/TypeBiensPage.tsx`
- **Wrong:** the shared field blocks (`QuartierFields`, `LayoutFields`) were components declared inside the page component. Every page re-render (e.g. the list finishing loading while the modal is open) created a new component type, so React remounted the inputs and cleared them; "Créer" then did nothing (empty `required` field) with no message.
- **Changed:** turned into render functions (`renderQuartierFields()`, `renderLayoutFields()`), so the inputs keep their identity.
  (Backend counterpart: `docs/fixes/Pagination.md` in the backend repo — the project list endpoint itself was double-paging.)

## Property type: edit always failed; activation toggle did nothing
- **Files:** `src/features/typebiens/TypeBiensPage.tsx` (backend: `TypeBiensController.cs`, `UpdateTypeBienHandler.cs`)
- **Wrong:** every "Modifier" failed with "TypeBien ID in the URL does not match the command ID" (the controller required an `id` in the body the client never sends). "Désactiver/Réactiver" sent an `active` field that does not exist server-side: nothing was saved and every type always showed "Actif".
- **Changed:** backend takes the id from the route; the non-functional toggle and "État" column were removed (deletion, guarded by the API, replaces it).
```
</details>

## 2. Ordre de livraison des scopes

L'ordre suit les dépendances d'état (une vente exige une visite validée, qui exige une
réservation approuvée, etc.) :

1. Scope 1 — Accès et rôles
2. Scope 4 — Réservations et documents
3. Scope 5 — Visite finale
4. Scope 6 — Vente manuelle et automatique
5. Scope 7 — Rendez-vous notaire
6. Scope 8 — Livraison et garantie
7. Scope 9 — Réclamations après-vente
8. Scope 2 — Projet, construction, dashboard
9. Scope 3 — Quartiers et types de biens
10. Scopes 10/11 — Sécurité serveur et intégrité (tests transverses, en dernier)

---

## 3. Infrastructure de test attendue

- `storageState` par rôle (un fichier d'authentification par rôle), généré dans un projet
  Playwright `setup`.
- Projets Playwright distincts par rôle pour éviter les fuites de session.
- **Fixtures d'état métier** exposant des helpers réutilisables :
  `createProject(status, constructionPct)`, `createReservation(state)`,
  `approveReservation()`, `createFinalVisit(result)`, `createDraftSale()`,
  `createNotaryAppointment(result)`, `deliverUnit()`, `createClaim()`.
  Ces helpers passent par l'API quand c'est possible, pour que chaque test UI ne re-teste que sa
  propre règle et pas tout le parcours amont.
- **Isolation** : chaque test crée ses propres données (projet/unité/acheteur dédiés) et ne
  dépend jamais de l'ordre d'exécution.
- **Nommage** : le nom du test est l'identifiant en `snake_case` donné ci-dessous, tel quel.
  Un fichier par scope : `tests/scope-01-roles.spec.ts`, etc.
- Après chaque mutation dans un test, vérifier l'état **rechargé depuis l'API/la page**, pas
  l'état optimiste affiché.

---

## 4. Scope 1 — Accès et rôles

**Agent commercial**
- `agent_cannot_create_project` — aucune action de création de projet accessible ; l'accès direct
  à la route de création est refusé.
- `agent_cannot_edit_project` — idem en modification.
- `agent_can_create_and_manage_reservation`
- `agent_can_create_and_manage_final_visit`
- `agent_can_create_draft_sale`
- `agent_can_create_or_confirm_notary_appointment_within_scope`
- `agent_blocked_on_project_outside_his_scope` — un projet hors périmètre n'est ni listé ni
  atteignable par URL directe.

**Administrateur de projet**
- `project_admin_can_crud_project_district_property_type`
- `project_admin_can_set_warranty_duration_on_project`
- `project_admin_can_approve_reservation`
- `project_admin_can_finalize_project_at_100_pct`
- `project_admin_finalize_rejected_below_100_pct` — refus explicite + statut inchangé après
  rechargement.
- `project_admin_can_create_and_edit_draft_sale`

**Acheteur**
- `buyer_sees_only_own_reservations_sales_visits_appointments_warranties_claims` — vérifier pour
  chacune des 6 collections, listes **et** accès par URL directe à l'identifiant d'un autre
  acheteur.
- `buyer_can_request_final_visit`
- `buyer_can_create_notary_appointment_request`

**Technicien / responsable technique**

- `technician_sees_only_assigned_claims`

---

## 5. Scope 2 — Projet, construction et catalogue

**Formulaire projet** — `project_form_persists_all_fields` couvrant, en création puis en
relecture après rechargement :
images multiples, lien vidéo, lien de visualisation 3D, un ou plusieurs types de biens, quartier
associé, statut du projet, pourcentage de construction, durée de garantie par défaut.
- `project_form_accepts_multiple_property_types`
- `project_form_accepts_multiple_images`

**Statuts projet**
- `sur_plan_allows_reservation_creation`
- `en_livraison_blocks_new_reservation` — création refusée, mais les dossiers déjà validés
  restent traitables : visite finale, vente et notaire demeurent accessibles.
- `finalise_makes_project_read_only` — toutes les actions métier sont grisées/désactivées.
- `finalise_transition_rejected_below_100_pct`
- `finalise_transition_only_by_project_admin`

**Dashboard** — `dashboard_shows_all_required_metrics`, un assert par indicateur :
nombre de réservations, montant total des réservations, taux de réservation, montant moyen de
réservation, progression de construction, nombre d'unités disponibles, réservées, vendues,
livrées.
- `dashboard_metrics_update_after_new_reservation` — valeurs recalculées après mutation.

---

## 6. Scope 3 — Quartiers et types de biens

**Quartiers**

ws_only_own_project_building_floor_unit_sale` — aucune donnée d'un autre

- `claim_form_persists_description_category_priority_attachments` — photos et pièces jointes
  incluses.

**Traitement**
- `claim_workflow_follows_state_machine` — SOUMISE → ASSIGNÉE → EN_COURS_D_EXAMEN →
  EN_RÉSOLUTION → RÉSOLUE → VALIDÉE/FERMÉE.
- `claim_invalid_transition_rejected` — tout saut d'étape est refusé.
- `tech_lead_can_view_assign_and_validate`
- `technician_can_add_work_done_comments_and_before_after_photos`
- `buyer_can_follow_progress_and_reply`

---

## 13. Scope 10 — Contraintes frontend

Ces points se vérifient pendant les scopes ci-dessus ; consigne les manquements dans
`tests/GAPS.md` :

- Les pages et adaptateurs existants sont réutilisés (projets, réservations, visites finales,
  notaire, ventes, livraison, SAV) — signale toute page dupliquée.
- `filesApi` et `ImageUploadField` sont utilisés pour images et documents — signale toute
  implémentation d'upload parallèle.
- Aucun second flux de livraison (cf. `no_duplicate_delivery_flow`).
- `forbidden_actions_hidden_or_disabled_by_role_and_status` — test transverse : pour chaque
  couple (rôle, statut), les actions interdites sont masquées ou désactivées.
- `ui_reloads_data_after_each_mutation` — après création/modification/suppression, les données
  affichées proviennent d'un appel API postérieur à la mutation.
- `buyer_pages_call_only_mine_endpoints` — intercepter le réseau sur chaque page acheteur et
  vérifier qu'aucune requête ne vise un endpoint global non filtré.

---

## 14. Scope 11 — Sécurité serveur (tests API, sans UI)

Le frontend n'est jamais une garantie de sécurité : ces tests appellent l'API directement avec
un token de rôle inadapté et attendent un refus (401/403), pas un masquage côté client.

- `api_rejects_role_violation` — pour chaque action sensible : création/modification de projet,
  approbation de réservation, finalisation de projet, confirmation de vente, validation de
  clôture de réclamation.
- `api_rejects_out_of_scope_project_access`
- `api_rejects_status_violation` — action métier appelée depuis un statut non autorisé
  (ex. réservation sur projet `FINALISE`, vente sur réservation non approuvée).
- `api_enforces_state_machine_transitions` — transitions invalides refusées pour réservation,
  vente, visite, rendez-vous notaire, réclamation.
- `api_upload_requires_token_role_ownership_and_project_scope` — quatre cas d'échec distincts.
- `api_rejects_file_access_from_non_owner`
- `api_atomic_on_purchase_completed` — cf. `auto_sale_creation_is_transactional`.

---

## 15. Scope 12 — Restitution finale

À la fin de la dernière tranche, produis `tests/REPORT.md` avec :

- Le tableau des cas : identifiant du test, scope, statut (passé / échoué / `fixme`), et pour
  chaque échec la règle de la spec violée.
- La liste des écarts `tests/GAPS.md` consolidée : endpoints de vente existants, modèle `Sale`
  existant, association projet ↔ type de bien, structures quartier/fonctionnalités, champs image
  /vidéo/3D, règles de documents obligatoires, autorisation d'upload et cause exacte du 403,
  règles actuelles de visite finale / notaire / livraison, cycle de réclamation et pièces
  jointes.
- Les doublons détectés (entités, pages, flux) à consolider plutôt qu'à recréer.

Principe directeur, identique à celui de la spec : **compléter l'existant, éviter les doublons,
et ne considérer une règle comme vérifiée que si elle est imposée côté backend et reflétée côté
frontend.**
```
</details>

    /// <summary>
    /// Associates an existing TypeBien to a Project.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpPost("{projectId}/type-biens")]
    [Authorize(Roles = RoleGroups.Admins)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> AssociateTypeBienToProject(Guid projectId, [FromBody] AssociateTypeBienToProjectCommand command)
    {
        command.ProjectId = projectId;
        var response = await _mediator.Send(command);
        return Ok(response);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets the list of TypeBiens associated with a specific Project.
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("{projectId}/type-biens")]
    [AllowAnonymous] // §6.3 Catalogue public.
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetTypeBiensByProject(Guid projectId)
    {
        var query = new GetTypeBiensByProjectQuery { ProjectId = projectId };
        var response = await _mediator.Send(query);
        return Ok(response);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets all TypeBiens (when no projectId is specified).
    /// </summary>
    [HttpGet("type-biens")]
    [AllowAnonymous] // §6.3 Catalogue public.
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAllTypeBiens()
    {
        var query = new GetTypeBiensByProjectQuery { ProjectId = null };
        var response = await _mediator.Send(query);
        return Ok(response);
    }

    ///
    /// A caller with no internal role (BUYER/PROSPECT) has no project
    /// perimeter at all — their access is per-file, via
    /// <see cref="EnsureBuyerOwnsReservationAsync"/>, not per-project. Applying
    /// the project check to them here would reject every buyer outright, since
    /// they hold no <see cref="Domain.Projects.Entities.ProjectMembership"/>
    /// row to begin with.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task EnsureReservationAccessAsync(Guid reservationId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (_user.IsGlobalAdmin) return;

        var isInternal = _user.Roles.Any(r => RoleCodes.Internal.Contains(r, StringComparer.Ordinal));
        if (!isInternal) return;

        var projectId = await (
            from r in _db.Set<Reservation>()
            join u in _db.Set<Domain.Immeubles.Entities.Unit>() on r.UnitId equals u.Id
            join im in _db.Set<Domain.Immeubles.Entities.Immeuble>() on u.ProjectId equals im.Id
            where r.Id == reservationId
            select im.ProjectId).FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

        if (projectId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            // Unresolvable ownership: fail closed rather than assume access.
            throw BusinessRuleException.ProjectScopeDenied(projectId);
        }

        await EnsureProjectAccessAsync(projectId, ct);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Resolves the project a unit belongs to (unit → immeuble → project) and
    /// applies the perimeter check for internal roles. Unlike
    /// <see cref="EnsureReservationAccessAsync"/>, a buyer/prospect caller is
    /// NOT waved through here — this only covers the internal-role half of
    /// the check. Callers reachable by buyers (e.g. a unit's title-status
    /// read, shown on both an internal unit page and a buyer's own property
    /// file) must also call <see cref="EnsureBuyerOwnsUnitAsync"/> for that
    /// caller shape; the two are deliberately separate so a caller that only
    /// makes sense for staff doesn't accidentally admit any buyer at all.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task EnsureUnitProjectAccessAsync(Guid unitId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (_user.IsGlobalAdmin) return;

        var isInternal = _user.Roles.Any(r => RoleCodes.Internal.Contains(r, StringComparer.Ordinal));
        if (!isInternal) return;

        var projectId = await (
            from u in _db.Set<Domain.Immeubles.Entities.Unit>()
            join im in _db.Set<Domain.Immeubles.Entities.Immeuble>() on u.ProjectId equals im.Id
            where u.Id == unitId
            select im.ProjectId).FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

        if (projectId == Guid.Empty)
        {
            // Unresolvable ownership: fail closed rather than assume access.
            throw BusinessRuleException.ProjectScopeDenied(projectId);
        }

        await EnsureProjectAccessAsync(projectId, ct);

## 🤖 Claude <sub>2026-09-14 13:36:45</sub>

Quick status:

**Passing, with the related code fixes done**
- **Scope 1, roles:** passes. The claim tests were updated to the new claim workflow and pass again.
- **Scope 4, reservations and documents:** passes.
- **Scope 5, final visit:** passes, except one test. `final_visit_shows_project_building_floor_unit` still needs a re-run; the unit page it failed on has been fixed.
- **Scope 6, sales:** passes.
- **Scope 7, notary:** passes.
- **Scope 8, delivery and warranty:** all 16 tests pass when run once. The duplicate "Livraisons" flow is gone from both backend and frontend, so handovers are the only delivery flow. I also fixed two bugs:
  - Editing a project that is in delivery always failed.
  - The buyer's delivery and warranty card disappeared silently when loading failed.
- **Scope 9, claims:** all 12 tests pass. This scope needed new work:
  - The workflow now follows the spec order: submitted → assigned → under review → in resolution → resolved → closed.
  - Each claim has a detail view with history, work-done messages, buyer replies and before/after photos.
  - The buyer's form lets them pick project, building, floor, unit and sale, and adds category, priority and attachments.
  - Access is restricted: the owner, the assigned technician, or a lead/admin within their projects.

**In progress**
- **Slowness:** when scopes 8 and 9 run twice in parallel, some tests time out. Headless Chrome sits at 100% CPU and SQL queries stall; the QA database now holds about 436 test projects and 400 reservations. I turned off SQL `AUTO_CLOSE` on the two QA databases and I'm still looking for the root cause.

**Not started**
- **Scope 2:** project form (videos, several property types, quartier, construction %), project status rules, dashboard figures.
- **Scope 3:** quartier features (title, description, optional image), property type photo, and refusing a minimum area larger than the maximum when creating.
- **Scope 10:** actions hidden per role and status, data reloaded after each change, buyer pages calling only "mine" endpoints.
- **Scope 11:** API security tests.
- **Scope 12:** `tests/REPORT.md` and `tests/GAPS.md`.
- **Workflow docs:** the `docs/workflows/*` pages with their Validated checklists.
- **Full run:** all scopes together, then a push of both repos.

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Common.Exceptions;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.Projects.Entities;
using ProjectAPI.Infrastructure.Context;

namespace ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Quartiers.DeleteQuartier;

/// <summary>
/// Deletes a quartier that no project references. A referenced quartier is
/// refused (409) rather than silently detaching its projects from the public
/// catalogue: the admin reassigns those projects first.
/// </summary>
public class DeleteQuartierCommand : IRequest<Unit>
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
}

public class DeleteQuartierHandler : IRequestHandler<DeleteQuartierCommand, Unit>
{
    private readonly ApplicationDbContext _db;

    public DeleteQuartierHandler(ApplicationDbContext db)
    {
        _db = db;
    }

    public async Task<Unit> Handle(DeleteQuartierCommand request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var quartier = await _db.Set<Quartier>().FirstOrDefaultAsync(q => q.Id == request.Id, ct)
            ?? throw new NotFoundException($"Quartier {request.Id} not found.");

        var projectCount = await _db.Set<Project>().CountAsync(p => p.QuartierId == request.Id, ct);
        if (projectCount > 0)
        {
            throw new BusinessRuleException(
                BusinessErrorCodes.InvalidStatusTransition,
                $"Ce quartier est rattaché à {projectCount} projet(s) : rattachez-les à un autre quartier avant de le supprimer.",
                StatusCodes.Status409Conflict);
        }

        _db.Remove(quartier);
        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
        return Unit.Value;
    }
}

﻿using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.Projects.Entities;

namespace ProjectAPI.Infrastructure.Configurations
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Configuration class for the <see cref="Quartier"/> entity.
    /// </summary>
    public class QuartierConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<Quartier>
    {
        public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<Quartier> builder)
        {
            builder.ToTable("Quartiers");

            builder.HasKey(q => q.Id);

            builder.Property(q => q.Name)
                .IsRequired()
                .HasMaxLength(200);

            builder.Property(q => q.Description)
                .HasMaxLength(2000)
                .IsRequired(false);

            builder.Property(q => q.Images)
                .HasMaxLength(20000)
                .IsRequired(false);

            // One-to-many: one Quartier => many Projects
            builder.HasMany(q => q.Projects)
                .WithOne(p => p.Quartier)
                .HasForeignKey(p => p.QuartierId)
                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.SetNull);
            // or Cascade, depending on your domain logic
        }
    }
}

﻿using ProjectAPI.Domain.Projects.Entities;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.Projects.Interfaces;

namespace ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Quartiers.CreateQuartier;

/// <summary>
/// Handler for creating a new quartier.
/// </summary>
public class CreateQuartierHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateQuartierCommand, CreateQuartierResponse>
{
    private readonly IQuartierRepository _quartierRepository;

    public CreateQuartierHandler(IQuartierRepository quartierRepository)
    {
        _quartierRepository = quartierRepository;
    }

    public async Task<CreateQuartierResponse> Handle(CreateQuartierCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Create the Quartier entity
        var quartier = new Quartier
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Name = request.Name,
            Description = request.Description,
            Images = request.Images
        };

        await _quartierRepository.InsertAsync(quartier);
        await _quartierRepository.SaveAsync();

        return new CreateQuartierResponse
        {
            Id = quartier.Id,
            Message = "Quartier created successfully."
        };
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Common.Exceptions;
using ProjectAPI.Domain.Common.Interfaces;

namespace ProjectAPI.Api.Application.Common.Media;

/// <summary>
/// Hosts the API will accept media links from, per kind.
///
/// An empty list is FAIL-CLOSED: only the API's own storage account is accepted
/// for that kind. Opening a kind to anywhere requires the explicit wildcard
/// entry <c>"*"</c> — a deployment cannot end up accepting arbitrary URLs by
/// forgetting to configure something.
/// </summary>
public class MediaSettings
{
    public const string SectionName = "Media";

    /// <summary>The one entry that disables host checking for a kind.</summary>
    public const string AnyHost = "*";

    public List<string> AllowedImageHosts { get; set; } = new();
    public List<string> AllowedVideoHosts { get; set; } = new();
    public List<string> Allowed3DHosts { get; set; } = new();
}

/// <summary>
/// Validates every media link the client supplies (§7.2 catalogue media).
///
/// A project image, a site video and a 3D-tour link are all rendered straight
/// into the public catalogue, so an unchecked string here is an injection point,
/// not a formatting nuisance: <c>javascript:</c> and <c>data:</c> URLs execute
/// in the visitor's page, and a plain <c>http:</c> link downgrades an https
/// page. The structural checks below refuse those outright.
///
/// On top of that, each kind carries a configurable host allow-list. The blob
/// account the API itself uploads to is ALWAYS allowed without being configured
/// — it is derived from the storage service rather than repeated in a settings
/// file, so rotating the account cannot silently lock the API out of its own
/// uploads.
/// </summary>
public class MediaUrlPolicy
{
    private readonly MediaSettings _settings;
    private readonly string? _ownStorageHost;

    public MediaUrlPolicy(IOptions<MediaSettings> settings, IBlobStorageService blobStorage)
    {
        _settings = settings.Value;

        // GetUrl does no round trip; it just formats the container's public URL.
        // A misconfigured or absent storage account must not stop validation
        // working, so anything unparseable simply contributes no extra host.
        try
        {
            var sample = blobStorage.ForContainer().GetUrl("probe");
            if (Uri.TryCreate(sample, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
            {
                _ownStorageHost = uri.Host;
            }
        }
        catch
        {
            _ownStorageHost = null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Project/quartier/type images. Throws 422 when refused.</summary>
    public void EnsureImageUrl(string? url, string field) =>
        Ensure(url, field, _settings.AllowedImageHosts, "image");

    /// <summary>Site-progress videos (§7.2 "espace temps réel").</summary>
    public void EnsureVideoUrl(string? url, string field) =>
        Ensure(url, field, _settings.AllowedVideoHosts, "vidéo");

    /// <summary>3D tour / virtual-visit links.</summary>
    public void Ensure3DLink(string? url, string field) =>
        Ensure(url, field, _settings.Allowed3DHosts, "visite 3D");

    /// <summary>
    public async Task<QuartierResponse> Handle(UpdateQuartierCommand request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var quartier = await _db.Set<Quartier>()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(q => q.Id == request.Id, ct)
            ?? throw new NotFoundException($"Quartier {request.Id} not found.");

        // A quartier spans projects, so there is no single project perimeter to
        // check against; the endpoint's own RoleGroups.Admins gate is the
        // boundary, as it is for every other cross-project referential.
        if (request.Images is not null && request.Images != quartier.Images)
        {
            _media.EnsureImageUrls(SplitImages(request.Images), "Images", SplitImages(quartier.Images));
            quartier.Images = request.Images;
        }

        quartier.Name = request.Name ?? quartier.Name;
        quartier.Description = request.Description ?? quartier.Description;

        await _db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);

        return new QuartierResponse
        {
            Id = quartier.Id,
            Name = quartier.Name,
            Description = quartier.Description,
            Images = quartier.Images,
            ProjectCount = await _db.Set<Project>().CountAsync(p => p.QuartierId == quartier.Id, ct)
        };
    }

    /// <summary>Quartier.Images is one comma-separated column, mirroring Project.Images.</summary>
    private static IEnumerable<string> SplitImages(string? packed) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(packed)
            ? Enumerable.Empty<string>()
            : packed.Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries);
}
```

namespace ProjectAPI.Api.Application.TypeBiens.CreateTypeBien
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Handler for creating a new TypeBien entity.
    /// </summary>
    public class CreateTypeBienHandler : IRequestHandler<CreateTypeBienCommand, CreateTypeBienResponse>
    {
        private readonly ITypeBienRepository _typeBienRepository;
        private readonly Common.Media.MediaUrlPolicy _media;

        public CreateTypeBienHandler(
            ITypeBienRepository typeBienRepository,
            Common.Media.MediaUrlPolicy media)
        {
            _typeBienRepository = typeBienRepository;
            _media = media;
        }

        public async Task<CreateTypeBienResponse> Handle(CreateTypeBienCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // §7.2 — reference data feeds the public catalogue like everything else.
            _media.EnsureImageUrl(request.Image, "Image");
            _media.EnsureImageUrls(TypeBienMedia.SplitImages(request.ImagesInterieur), "ImagesInterieur");
            _media.Ensure3DLink(request.Module3DLink, "Module3DLink");

            // Construct the new TypeBien entity
            var entity = new TypeBien
            {
                // Id is auto-generated if it's an identity, else set manually
                Name = request.Name,
                Description = request.Description,
                Image = request.Image,
                Price = request.Price,
                NbrChambre = request.NbrChambre,
                NbrSalleDeBain = request.NbrSalleDeBain,
                NbrDouche = request.NbrDouche,
                NbrParking = request.NbrParking,
                MinSurface = request.MinSurface,
                MaxSurface = request.MaxSurface,
                ImagesInterieur = request.ImagesInterieur,
                Module3DLink = request.Module3DLink
            };

            // Insert and save
            await _typeBienRepository.InsertAsync(entity);
            await _typeBienRepository.SaveAsync();

            return new CreateTypeBienResponse
            {
                Id = entity.Id,
                Message = "TypeBien created successfully."
            };
        }
    }
}

import type { TypeBien } from "../../types";
import type { TypeBiensApi } from "../interfaces";
import { projectFetch } from "./client";

export const typeBiensApi: TypeBiensApi = {
  async list() {
    // TypeBiensController has no GET; the only list source is ProjectsController.
    return projectFetch<TypeBien[]>("/api/Projects/type-biens");
  },
  async create(data) {
    const res = await projectFetch<{ id: number; message: string }>("/api/TypeBiens", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify(data),
    });
    return { id: res.id, ...data } as TypeBien;
  },
  async update(id, data) {
    await projectFetch<unknown>(`/api/TypeBiens/${id}`, {
      method: "PUT",
      body: JSON.stringify(data),
    });
    return { id, ...data } as TypeBien;
  },
  async remove(id) {
    await projectFetch<unknown>(`/api/TypeBiens/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
  },
};

err.message : \"Échec de la modification du quartier.\");\n    } finally {\n      setBusy(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async function onRemove(q: Quartier) {\n    if (!window.confirm(`Supprimer le quartier « ${q.name} » ?`)) return;\n    setBusy(true);\n    try {\n      await projectsApi.removeQuartier(q.id);\n      setLoadError(null);\n      reload();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setLoadError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : \"Échec de la suppression du quartier.\");\n    } finally {\n      setBusy(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Shared by create and edit so the two forms cannot drift apart. */\n  // A render function, not a nested component: a component declared inside\n  // the page gets a new identity on every render, so React remounted the\n  // inputs (wiping what the user typed) whenever the list reloaded.\n  function renderQuartierFields(value?: Quartier) {\n    return (\n      <>\n        <Field label=\"Nom\">\n          <input name=\"name\" defaultValue={value?.name ?? \"\"} maxLength={200} required disabled={busy} />\n        </Field>\n        <Field label=\"Description\">\n          <textarea name=\"description\" rows={3} defaultValue={value?.description ?? \"\"} disabled={busy} />\n        </Field>\n        {/* Facultative. Stored server-side as one comma-separated column. */}\n        <ImageUploadField label=\"Images (facultatif)\" value={images} onChange={setImages} />\n      </>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div>\n      <PageHeader\n        title=\"Quartiers\"\n        subtitle=\"Référentiel des quartiers auxquels les projets sont rattachés\"\n        actions={<Button onClick={openCreate}>+ Nouveau quartier</Button>}\n      />\n      <Card>\n        {loadError && <p className=\"form-error\" role=\"alert\">{loadError}</p>}\n        {!items ?
